items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Lavern Floyd? [INTERVIEWEE] Uh huh, yeah. Uh huh. Yeah, I heard that one.

ctx.x: But I remember when I first came here, in '29, the guy that they were talking about most, his name was Rebb Spikes. That's the guy that seemed to have had -- and Jack McVea's dad was getting all the gigs, the banjo player. But that Ellighew, I don't remember hearing that.
Uh huh, yeah. Uh huh. Yeah, I heard that one.
